paragraphs: Hello! I'm Himanshu, a passionate Full Stack Web & App Developer originally from Dehradun, the picturesque capital of Uttarakhand nestled in the Himalayan foothills. Currently pursuing my graduation in Nagpur, Maharashtra, where I'm turning my tech dreams into reality.

Coming from the "Queen of Hills" to the "Orange City," my journey reflects my adaptability and drive. I focus on developing elegant solutions that balance form and function, bringing together the serenity of my hometown and the vibrancy of my university city in every project I create.

location.locationSectionCopy: Currently crafting digital experiences from the Dehradun, India.

responsibilities: Developed and maintained multiple enterprise-grade web and mobile applications using React, Next.js, React Native, and NestJS, delivering scalable, high-performance solutions.
Built robust RESTful APIs and backend services with NestJS, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Prisma ORM to support real-time features, analytics, and AI-driven workflows.

Designed and shipped production-ready features across products, including AI integrations, LMS platforms, analytics tools, and mobile apps, ensuring reliable infrastructure and seamless user experiences.

experience.role: Full Stack Web and App Developer
responsibilities: Built an AI-agentic mobile browser for iOS and Android with React Native, integrating Meta LLaMA, Langchain, Together AI, Groq, and Node.js.
Developed real-time speech-to-speech voice agents with Hume AI and Twilio, and enabled offline LLM inference with ONNX for performance and privacy.
Implemented decentralized history storage using IPFS and BNB blockchain with secure, scalable webhook architecture.
Developed and optimized a high-traffic Svelte app supporting 70,000–100,000+ weekly users, focusing on performance and scalability.
Built frontend solutions with Next.js and React.js, including server-side components for efficient data handling.
Designed and implemented custom analytics dashboards with Google Analytics and Facebook Insights.
Built web and desktop apps using React, Next.js, Electron.js, Tauri, and MERN stack, delivering performant cross-platform solutions.
Developed and deployed smart contracts on Binance Smart Chain (BSC) with blockchain integrations.
Explored Unreal Engine Pixel Streaming and contributed to AI-driven applications, deepening expertise in decentralized technologies.
